notes.title: Two releases - Muv-Luv Unlimited : The Day After and Muv-Luv Alternative Manga!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32208705/7c875460e5be54041093236bab311a0b50b2a485.jpg[/img]

We at aNCHOR are proud to announce the official release of our newest localized title, Muv-Luv Unlimited: The Day After! All 4 episodes will be available on Steam starting today - February 5th, 2021!

[previewyoutube=wKkvbuLhEns;full][/previewyoutube]

Picking up directly where Muv-Luv Unlimited left off, witness the aftermath of Alternative V, as the last remnants of humanity fight a desperate battle for survival on a barren and desolate Earth! Featuring a brand-new cast (with some returning fan-favorites thrown in for good measure!) and all-new challenges to face, this epic four-part saga is sure to please longtime fans and newcomers alike!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1407100

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1407090

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1342410

https://store.steampowered.com/app/789830

[h2]New Steam Bundles are now available![/h2]

1. Muv-Luv Unlimited : The Day After ULTIMATE COLLECTION bundle have all TDA episodes at 10% off!
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/18646/

2. Muv-Luv War and Peace bundle have the main trilogy, photonflowers and photonmelodies at 10% off
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/18795/MuvLuv_War_and_Peace/

3. Muv-Luv MEGAVERSE have all titles at 15% off!
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/11706/MuvLuv_MEGAVERSE/

[h1]Muv-Luv Alternative manga volumes 1-4 added as DLC![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32208705/c68315edd224756a14eb863a29055f8926e8ea97.png[/img]

Due to popular demand, Muv-Luv Alternative manga is now also available on Steam! We'll be uploading the manga in bundles - the first four volumes for now, then once we've published volume 8, we'll have the next bundle DLC available.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1501130/MuvLuv_Alternative_Manga_Super_Bundle_1/

There are five volumes available as of writing, and if you wish to read volumes 5, you can also download the manga separately on [url=https://gumroad.com/muvluv]Gumroad[/url] or [url=https://www.amazon.com/s?i=digital-text&rh=p_27%3AAzusa+Makishima]Kindle[/url]. Volume 6 will be available on February 26. Follow our [url=https://twitter.com/muvluvseries]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/muvluvseries]Facebook[/url] to stay updated!

notes.title: CODEX Minor Update
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1251940/MuvLuv_Alternative_CODEX/

We've updated the CODEX PDF version so the quality of the images are higher, and most of the text can be highlighted now.

For reference, the previous size of the CODEX is 255MB, while the new version is [b]438MB.[/b]

If the CODEX hasn't automatically updated yet, simply re-login or restart your Steam client.

Cheers,

The Muv-Luv Team

notes.title: Muv-Luv Alternative CODEX is Live!
notes.content:
Due to popular demand, we added the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1251940/MuvLuv_Alternative_CODEX/]Muv-Luv Alternative CODEX[/url][/b] as a downloadable content for Muv-Luv Alternative! Upon downloading the DLC, the PDF will be available inside your local game directory.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1251940/MuvLuv_Alternative_CODEX/

[url=https://aaltomies.wordpress.com/tag/muv-luv-alternative-integral-works/]Muv-Luv Alternative CODEX originated from "Muv-Luv Alternative Integral Works"[/url], it is the definitive "bible" of the franchise, with the English version made possible by [b][url=http://kickstarter.com/projects/muvluv/muv-luv-a-pretty-sweet-visual-novel-series/]Muv-Luv Kickstarter backers![/url][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32208722/b93eb879c35fca6fb32e8585e2b5bcdddc8d99eb.jpg[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32208722/415041f70a8ca90b62c4d46764f4157b82ee8a59.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32208722/5edafced03abb9d08262bce3cf837494c9dacbd8.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32208722/8f43428dbe25b68c1c0d45c3f493dae1f65ff35e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32208722/234dcc87a081150a85b58be10b1b9ea31e9052fa.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32208722/fa2dba1580bd91e96a3dc2d4c9a8355a92937515.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32208722/4bb70d6288f985d6068a1213a762e99ac223fcd5.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32208722/de32bec9b0c50ee475b50c257b7ff2dea3bca08c.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32208722/e7891085762651e2fd28101862c4623c9027227a.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32208722/37f3561a986a8189c533b8a68c7eafccec0616d1.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32208722/4900fa28f8a7f75c6ddda17154cb20ca6bd78a85.jpg[/img][/url]

The physical and digital versions of the CODEX are exclusive rewards for Muv-Luv Kickstarter backers, and after several requests from fans who missed the campaign and reaching an agreement with our partners, the digital PDF version of the CODEX is now made available for the public!

[h2]Follow our publisher page to stay updated about upcoming releases![/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/anchor][b]https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/anchor[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32208722/646a8eb44a504038bf859a4b35e1dae339a66035.jpg[/img][/url]

Cheers,

The Muv-Luv Team

notes.title: Muv-Luv Summer Sale!
notes.content:
Now's the best time to grab the epic Muv-Luv trilogy!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/802880/MuvLuv/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/802890/MuvLuv_Alternative/
Be sure to share the luv to your friends, to give them happiness and joy they deserve :)

[h1]Muv-Luv Extra/Unlimited June Update is Live[/h1]

We have an update for Muv-Luv Extra/Unlimited today, which addresses the typos and text errors identified by the community since the official release.

If you have the patch installed:
1. For Backers - Please re-download the Director's Cut DLC in BackerKit (with the suffix "June 2018") 
2. For Steam users - Denpasoft sent an e-mail today containing details about the updated patch version.

If you don't wish to update the game, you can revert to "Ancient" branch under properties->Betas.

[h1]Muv-Luv Alternative Director's Cut DLC Released![/h1]

MLA Director's Cut DLC is now available in Denpasoft with a 10% discount!
We sincerely thank everyone for making yet another one of our promises become a reality. We couldn't have made it this far without your support!

Best,

The Muv-Luv Team
